parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Cross-Platform Repurposer
Send any post + source platform via webhook.
GPT-4o rewrites for each platform's native style:
- Twitter: single sharpest insight, under 280 chars
- Instagram: hook + line breaks + hashtags
- WhatsApp: personal message feel, 50-80 words
- Threads: punchy, can be 3-post thread
- Newsletter: slightly formal, 80-100 words
Saves to Notion + Slack preview.
